# Validate inputs
    arrays = [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]
    names = ["logp_with_result", "logp_call_only", "logp_no_call"]
    for arr, name in zip(arrays, names):
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must have nonpositive values (<= 0)")
    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    n, m = logp_with_result.shape
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(m)  # offsets 0..m-1
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)  # shape (m,)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)  # shape (m,)

    # Weighted sums
    weighted_with = np.dot(logp_with_result, normalized_weights)  # (n,)
    weighted_call = np.dot(logp_call_only, normalized_weights)
    weighted_no = np.dot(logp_no_call, normalized_weights)

    # Max of no_call and call_only
    max_other = np.maximum(weighted_call, weighted_no)  # (n,)

    # Margins (handle tau_filter == 0 to avoid division by zero)
    if tau_filter == 0:
        margins = weighted_with - max_other
    else:
        margins = (weighted_with - max_other) / tau_filter

    keep = margins > 0
    return keep, margins
